name: status and conditional lists
source:
false
printf '%s\n' "$?"
false && echo no || echo fallback
true || echo no && echo yes
if false; then echo no; fi
printf 'if=%s\n' "$?"
while false; do echo no; done
printf 'while=%s\n' "$?"

name: loop status
source:
x=yes
while test "$x" = yes; do x=no; false; done

source:

source:
failed=''
for path in "$@"; do
    if [ -f "$path" ]; then
        printf 'File: %s\n' "$path"
        grep -F ERROR "$path"
    else
        printf 'Missing: %s\n' "$path" >&2
        failed=yes
    fi
done
if [ -n "$failed" ]; then
    exit 2
fi
exit 0
